name: NASA FIRMS Fire Detections (NZ)
description: Ingests NASA FIRMS active fire detections (MODIS and VIIRS S-NPP/NOAA-20/NOAA-21 KMZ feeds) for a configurable New Zealand bounding box, clusters and filters them by confidence and fire radiative power, optionally annotates them with FENZ fire season status, and posts them to the map.

permissions.description: Submits fire detection CoT features to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls the NASA FIRMS 24h KMZ feeds for new fire detections on a schedule.
